case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr. Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the long cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Our own data shows a different picture on delivery reliability:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we have put together options for you. Option A and Option B give you a longer contract and a longer payment term, while Option C keeps your payment term as it is:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.67; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.78; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of them works for you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We value our long-standing partnership and have taken your feedback regarding delivery performance into account. 

We are pleased to offer the requested 24-month contract term; however, for this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material cost fluctuations. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our primary Angebot provides a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Accordingly, we propose a revised price of €5.60 per unit with 30 days net payment and the AS-14404 index clause. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This option features a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

Option B: unit price EUR 4.77; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A and Option B give you a longer payment term in exchange for the price, while Option C keeps payment at your standard term. We would be glad to settle this together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your revised offers and your commitment to finding a fair solution. 

As your trusted trading partner, we always strive to support your needs and maintain our strong relationship. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Currently, our offer stands at a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. In response to your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.50 per unit for a 24-month contract with 60 days net payment and the AS-14404 index clause. This concession reflects our willingness to meet you partway while maintaining a sustainable basis for our long-standing cooperation. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
